purpose: Express indecision about whether to act.
keywords: V volitional + か + V dictionary + まいか
I am undecided about whether to tell the truth.
I looked at the sky, wondering whether to take an umbrella.
I spent the night wondering whether to send the letter.
formation: V volitional + か + V dictionary + まいか
restrictions: The same action appears in affirmative intention and negative intention.
mistake: For する, するまいか or すまいか may occur; maintain matching action meanings.
